To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) school connectedness is associated with lower rates of suicide risk, attempted suicide and self-harm; 2) religious mismatch is associated with higher rates of attempted suicide, suicide risk and self-harm, and 3) these associations are independent of neighbourhood and individual factors.
